subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased SHA replace all 14 third-party action revisions in secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, repository-automation, and agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow but changes upstream code executing with privileged credentials; owner intent and direct dependency verification are required before accepting that security boundary.

options.title: Approve after dependency audit
options.body: Verify release-to-SHA identity, permissions, inputs, outputs, defaults, and Codex runtime compatibility on the final rebased head before merging.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate setup-only action updates from token, publishing, CodeQL, Docker, and Codex updates for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Keep the PR open until direct upstream and Codex inspection plus exact-head validation are available.

recommendation.title: Approve after dependency audit
recommendation.body: Verify release-to-SHA identity, permissions, inputs, outputs, defaults, and Codex runtime compatibility on the final rebased head before merging.
